question:
The ratio of the ages of A and B, four years ago, was 4 : 5. Eight years from now, the ratio of the ages of A and B will be 11 : 13. What is the sum of their present ages?

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 80 years.

The difference is not the same, so equate the difference in their ages

3 units = 12 years

1 unit = 4 years

The present age of A = 8 × 4 + 4 = 36 years

The present age of B = 10 × 4 + 4 = 44 years

Sum = 36 + 44 = 80 years

(CGL 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 80 वर्ष है।

अंतर समान नहीं है, इसलिए उनकी उम्र के अंतर को समान मानें

B की वर्तमान आयु = 10 × 4 + 4 = 44 वर्ष

योग = 36 + 44 = 80 वर्ष

question:
A father said to his son, 'n years back I was as old as you are now. My present age is four times your age, n years back.' If the sum of the present ages of the father and the son is 130 years, what is the difference in their ages?

(UPSC CSAT 2024)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 30 years.

Let son's present age be x, then

Father's present age = 130 - x

n years ago

⇒ 130 - x - n = x

⇒ 2x = 130 - n

⇒ n = 130 - 2x....(1)

Father’s present age = 4 × (son’s age n years ago)

130 - x = 4(x - n)

From equation 1

⇒ 130 - x = 4(x - (130 - 2x))

⇒ 130 - x = 4(x - 130 + 2x)

⇒ 130 - x = 4(3x - 130)

⇒ 130 - x = 12x - 520

⇒ 13x = 650

⇒ x = 50

Father's age = 130 - x = 80 years

Difference in age = 80 - 50 = 30 years
question_hi:
एक पिता ने अपने बेटे से कहा, 'n वर्ष पहले मैं तुम्हारी वर्तमान आयु के बराबर था। मेरी वर्तमान आयु n वर्ष पहले की तुम्हारी आयु से चार गुना है।' यदि पिता और पुत्र की वर्तमान आयु का योग 130 वर्ष है, तो उनकी आयु में क्या अंतर है?

(UPSC CSAT 2024)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात 30 वर्ष है।

मान लीजिए बेटे की वर्तमान आयु x है, तो

पिता की वर्तमान आयु = 130 - x

n वर्ष पहले

⇒ 130 - x - n = x

⇒ 2x = 130 - n

⇒ n = 130 - 2x....(1)

पिता की वर्तमान आयु = 4 × (बेटे की n वर्ष पहले की आयु)

130 - x = 4(x - n)

समीकरण 1 से

⇒ 130 - x = 4(x - (130 - 2x))

⇒ 130 - x = 4(x - 130 + 2x)

⇒ 130 - x = 4(3x - 130)

⇒ 130 - x = 12x - 520

⇒ 13x = 650

⇒ x = 50

पिता की आयु = 130 - x = 80 वर्ष

आयु में अंतर = 80 - 50 = 30 वर्ष

question:
The present age of a husband and wife is in the ratio 5 : 4. After 6 years, their ages will be in the ratio 6 : 5. At the time of their marriage, the ratio of their ages was 4 : 3. In how many years ago were they married?

SP 2023 Phase-11 Graduation L.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 6 years.

1 unit → 6 years

5 unit → 6 × 5 = 30 years

4 unit → 4 × 6 = 24 years

Let their marriage take place before x years

⇒ \({30-x}\over{24-x}\) = \(4\over3\)

⇒ 90 - 3x = 96 - 4x

⇒ x = 6 years
question_hi:

SP 2023 Phase-11 Graduation L.
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 6 वर्ष है।

5 इकाई → 6 × 5 = 30 वर्ष

4 इकाई → 4 × 6 = 24 वर्ष

मान लीजिए कि उनकी शादी x वर्ष पहले हुई थी

⇒ \({30-x}\over{24-x}\) = \(4\over3\)

⇒ 90 - 3x = 96 - 4x

⇒ x = 6 वर्ष

question:
Five years from now, the ratio of the ages of A, B, and C will be 3 : 5 : 2. The sum of the squares of their present ages is 525. What is the present age of B?

(MTS 2021)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 20 years.

Consider the present ages of A, B and C in such a way that after adding 5 to the age of A, it gets reduced by 3, after adding 5 to the age of B, it gets reduced by 5 and after adding 5 to the age of C, it gets reduced by 2 because the ratio of the ages of A : B : C after 5 years will be 3 : 5 : 2.

⇒ (10)2 + (20)2 + (5)2 = 525

These values completely satisfy all the conditions.

Present age of B = 20 years
question_hi:
अब से पाँच वर्ष बाद, A, B और C की आयु का अनुपात 3 : 5 : 2 होगा। उनकी वर्तमान आयु के वर्गों का योग 525 है। B की वर्तमान आयु क्या है?

(MTS 2021)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 20 वर्ष है।

A, B और C की वर्तमान आयु पर इस प्रकार विचार करें कि A की आयु में 5 जोड़ने पर वह 3 कम हो जाती है, B की आयु में 5 जोड़ने पर वह 5 कम हो जाती है तथा C की आयु में 5 जोड़ने पर वह 2 कम हो जाती है क्योंकि 5 वर्ष पश्चात A : B : C की आयु का अनुपात 3 : 5 : 2 होगा।

⇒ (10)2 + (20)2 + (5)2 = 525

ये मान सभी शर्तों को पूर्णतः संतुष्ट करते हैं।

B की वर्तमान आयु = 20 वर्ष

question:
The sum of the ages of 6 children born at the interval of two years each is 90 years. What is the age (in years) of the eldest child?

question:

question:

solution_hi:

question:
The age of a father will be double the age of his son ten years later. 10 years ago, the father's age was six times the age of the son. How many years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 3 : 2?

(CHSL 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 35.

    4 unit → 20 years

    1 unit → 5 years

The ratio of their ages will be 3 : 2 after x years

F = 40 years, and S = 15 years

⇒ \({40+x}\over{15+x}\) = \(3\over2\)

⇒ 80 + 2x = 45 + 3x

⇒ x = 35 years

question:
The average age of A, B, and C is 20 years. Two years ago, the sum of the ages of A and B was 6 more than that of C. Find the present age of C.

(CGL 2023 Mains)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 26 years.

Two years ago, the sum of their ages = (20 - 2) × 3 = 54 years

.:. A + B + C = 54

As the sum of (A + B) is 6 more than C,

Hence, (C + 6) + C = 54

⇒ 2C = 48

⇒ C = 24 years

.:. Present age of C = 24 + 2 = 26 years

question:
The sum of the ages of Arun and Bharti is 24 years, such that Arun is older. If the age of Arun and Bharti is doubled, the difference is 8 years. What is the age of Arun? (in years)

(CHSL 2022 Mains)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 14.

Arun  :  Bharti

 x        :     y

⇒ x + y = 24 ....(1)

2x - 2y = 8

⇒ x - y = 4....(2)

Adding equations 1 and 2

⇒ 2x = 28

⇒ x = \({28}\over2\) = 14 years
